settings.title: System Settings
settings.apiBaseUrlDescription: The API base URL for downstream clients to connect to this proxy, displayed on the dashboard
settings.allowRegistrationDescription: Allow new users to register accounts
settings.captchaEnabledDescription: Protect dashboard login and registration with built-in Cap. Disabling this removes bot and credential-stuffing protection.
settings.sessionDurationDescription: How long user sessions remain valid. Default 7 days, minimum 1 day.
settings.maxApiKeysDescription: Maximum number of API keys each user can create. Default 1000, minimum 1.
settings.reasoningSuffixMapDescription: Map model name suffixes to reasoning effort levels. When a requested model has no exact match, suffixes are stripped to find the base model and the mapped effort level is injected.
settings.globalTransformsHelp: Rules run in order within each stage.
settings.globalModelRedirectsDescription: Rewrite downstream model names before allowlists, routing, billing, and transforms. API-key rules take priority.
settings.globalModelRedirectsEmpty: No global redirects. Model names pass through unchanged unless an API key has its own rule.
settings.globalModelRedirectsHelp: Full-match Rust regular expressions. First match wins; maximum 32 rules.
settings.affinityRoutingDescription: Control whether requests from the same Agent thread stay on the selected Channel after routing or fallback. Channel settings can override each global value.
settings.affinityEnabledDescription: Keep an active Agent thread on its selected Provider and Channel until the binding expires or becomes ineligible.
settings.affinityIdleTtlSecondsDescription: Remove a binding after this long without a successful request. Each success refreshes the idle timer. Default 1800 seconds, minimum 1 second.
settings.affinityFailbackModeDescription: Keep the current fallback Channel, or retry normal Provider priority after the failback delay.
settings.affinityFailbackDelaySecondsDescription: Under Prefer Higher Priority, wait this long from binding creation before an earlier eligible Provider can replace the current target. Default 300 seconds, minimum 0.
settings.activeProbeEnabledDescription: When enabled, unhealthy Channels are periodically probed for recovery.
settings.enableEstimatedBillingDescription: When enabled, Monoize may charge from estimated usage when upstream usage is missing.
settings.requestCaptureEnabledDescription: Master switch for per-API-key request capture dumps. When off, no dump files are written.
settings.requestCaptureMaxTotalMibDescription: When total capture dump size exceeds this limit, the oldest dumps are deleted first. Default 1024 MiB. 0 disables the limit.
settings.maskSensitiveInfoDescription: Mask upstream URLs, domains, IPs, and API keys in client-facing error messages and non-admin request-log reads. When off, raw upstream error text is exposed.
settings.stripCrossProtocolNestedExtraDescription: Remove nested downstream-only passthrough state before cross-family upstream encoding.
settings.activeProbeIntervalSecondsDescription: How often active probe runs. Default 30 seconds, minimum 1 second.
settings.activeProbeSuccessThresholdDescription: Consecutive successful probes required to mark a Channel healthy. Default 1, minimum 1.
settings.activeProbeModelPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the Provider's first model
settings.activeProbeModelDescription: When set, this model is used for completion probes on all Providers.
settings.passiveFailureThresholdDescription: This many failures within the sampling window trigger a circuit break. Default 3, minimum 1.
settings.passiveCooldownSecondsDescription: Cooldown duration after passive breaker opens for transient failures. Default 60 seconds, minimum 1 second.
settings.passiveWindowSecondsDescription: Sliding time window used for passive failure-count calculation. Default 30 seconds, minimum 1 second.
settings.passiveRateLimitCooldownSecondsDescripti: Short cooldown used when breaker opens due to rate-limit pressure (HTTP 429). Default 15 seconds, minimum 1 second.
settings.requestTimeoutMsDescription: Global default timeout for upstream requests. Providers can override this value. Default 30000 ms (30 seconds), minimum 1 ms.
settings.effortValues: Valid: none, minimum, low, medium, high, xhigh, max
settings.codexModelsDescription: Choose the small, intentional model catalog shown by Codex clients connected to Monoize.
settings.codexModelsLegend: Models shown in the Codex model picker
settings.codexModelsCompatibilityHelp: The standard OpenAI data list still contains every available model. This selection controls only the extended models catalog consumed by Codex.
settings.extraFieldsWhitelistDescription: Additional fields allowed to pass through to each upstream API type, extending the built-in defaults.
settings.extraFieldsWhitelistHelp: Comma-separated field names per upstream type. Leave empty to use built-in defaults only.
settings.allowFreeWhenUnpricedDescription: When no model price row exists, settle at zero charge instead of rejecting the request. Default off (fail closed).
settings.allowFreeWhenMissingUsage: Allow free settlement when usage is missing
settings.allowFreeWhenMissingUsageDescription: When the upstream omits usage on a billable response, settle at zero charge instead of rejecting. Default off (fail closed).
settings.dashboardPerformanceDescription: Choose groups and models shown on the user dashboard performance panel. Metrics are global aggregates for the last 24 hours.
settings.rechargePublicOriginDescription: Public http/https origin (no path) used to build payment notify and return URLs. Order creation requires a non-empty value.
